params._note_jobid: label_job/tool1_job/build_job PHAI khop cong thuc trong cmd_*_export/cmd_wfo_build_ds (basename cua out_csv/out_dir/out_ds, non-alnum->'_'). Doi duong dan thi doi *_job kem theo.
params._note_label_dir: label_csv nam TRONG label_dataset_dir rieng (KHONG chung voi tool1_dir/out_ds/pred_dir) de kaggle_dataset_push chi upload dung 2 file (csv + .meta.json sidecar), khong keo theo file khac.
params._note_no_nested_subst: label_csv viet LITERAL (khong dung ${label_dataset_dir} long trong) vi engine _subst chi thay THE 1 LAN, KHONG resolve tham chieu long nhau giua params. Doi label_dataset_dir qua CLI K=V thi PHAI doi label_csv kem theo (2 gia tri doc lap, khong tu dong khop).

steps._note: ExportFundingLabel (FileOutputStream) KHONG tu tao thu muc cha — phai mkdir truoc.

Copy 1-chieu tu ml/training + ml/lib (nguon that duy nhat) vao kernel dir. KHONG bao gio sua tay cac file _gen_*.py / funding_label_pb*.py / tool1_col.py trong kernel_dir. [2026-08-07 TASK-251] PHAI copy CA 2 file decoder protobuf (funding_label_pb.py + binding funding_label_pb2.py sinh tu src/main/proto/funding_label.proto): label gio la protobuf columnar, thieu decoder thi kernel Kaggle chet ngay o buoc import. CUNG NGAY DO: PHAI copy tool1_col.py (reader Tool1 dinh dang T1C1 .t1c.gz, sinh boi Tool1ColSink.java) — thieu no thi buoc build_features() chet ngay o import.

steps.question: validate_report_only vua chay xong -> xem ${out_ds}/validation_report.txt. CANH BAO: pipe_resume voi BAT KY answer nao (llm_gate KHONG re nhanh theo noi dung tra loi) se DI TIEP toi step sign_manifest, va sign_manifest se TU KY VALIDATED_BY NEU report.result=PASS luc do (fail-closed nam trong chinh wfo_validate, khong nam trong gate nay). Neu CHUA muon ky (can xem lai thu cong): dung pipe_stop <pipe_id> tai step nay, KHONG goi pipe_resume. Chi pipe_resume khi da xem report va dong y ky.
